title: Klint Kubiak: A lot of tape to watch to determine who first pick will be

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: A lot of tape to watch to determine who first pick will be
sources.description: The Raiders introduced Klint Kubiak as their head coach at a press conference on Thursday and one of the first questions he fielded had to do with the first overall pick in this year's draft.
